description: This file provides a set of utility functions to determine the verification status of a Matrix device, based on properties of the MatrixDeviceVerificationStatusLike object.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceLocallyVerified( isMatrixDeviceLocallyVerified
methods.description: Checks if the device has been locally verified by examining the localVerified property.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified( isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified
methods.description: Determines if the device is owner-verified via crossSigningVerified or signedByOwner properties.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceVerifiedInCurrentClient( isMatrixDeviceVerifiedInCurrentClient
methods.description: Aggregates verification checks, including an explicit method call and other checks, to determine overall device verification status.
